items.title: AI-designed universal coronavirus vaccine passes first human trial
items.raw_excerpt: Scientists have successfully tested an AI-designed universal coronavirus vaccine in humans for the first time, finding it to be safe and well tolerated. The vaccine generated immune responses against multiple coronaviruses, including SARS-CoV-2, SARS, and related bat viruses with pandemic potential. By targeting features shared across an entire virus family, it aims to provide protection even as viruses evolve.

items.title: Who here still codes without AI, and why?
items.raw_excerpt: As someone who loves coding (uses vim, and has done so for ~10 years), but also is amazed by AI coding tools and has embraced them recently (e.g. copilot then claude code then codex), I'm curious, who out there is still not using any of these tools? And if not, why? I feel it's become as common-place as autocomplete, or intellisense. Though I remember people used to hate those too. I guess AI is like the modern day intellisense + docs targeted for exactly what you're doing, always (maybe that + an intern that never sleeps)

items.title: OpenAI正准备对ChatGPT进行上线以来最大幅度升级
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI 正准备对 ChatGPT 进行上线以来最大幅度升级，此次升级也引爆了人工智能热潮。这家估值 8500 亿美元的集团计划在今年上市前寻找新的增长引擎。该公司打算将这款聊天机器人转型为 “超级应用”，整合编程工具与人工智能智能体，新增多款高管认为能带来更高收入的产品。据十多位现任及前任员工透露，这些调整是 OpenAI 整体重组计划的一部分。这家总部位于旧金山的公司正调配资源，全力争取高利润企业客户，并与竞争对手 Anthropic 展开更激烈的竞争。此次调整将提升 OpenAI 编程产品 Codex 的地位并增加资源投入，反映出公司内部日益坚定的共识：人工智能的未来并非回答问题的聊天机器人，而是能为用户执行任务的智能体。（新浪财经）

excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI is preparing for the most significant upgrade to ChatGPT since its launch, which has also ignited an artificial intelligence boom. The $850 billion-valued group plans to seek new growth engines before going public this year. The company intends to transform the chatbot into a "super app," integrating programming tools with AI agents and adding multiple products that executives believe will generate higher revenue. According to over a dozen current and former employees, these adjustments are part of OpenAI's overall restructuring plan. The San Francisco-based company is reallocating resources to aggressively pursue high-margin enterprise clients and intensify competition with rival Anthropic. The changes will elevate the status of OpenAI's programming product Codex and increase resource investment, reflecting a growing internal consensus that the future of AI lies not in chatbots that answer questions, but in agents that execute tasks for users. (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI se prepara para realizar la mayor actualización de ChatGPT desde su lanzamiento, una mejora que ha desatado la fiebre de la inteligencia artificial. El grupo, valorado en 850 000 millones de dólares, planea buscar nuevos motores de crecimiento antes de su salida a bolsa este año. La compañía pretende transformar este chatbot en una "superaplicación", integrando herramientas de programación y agentes de inteligencia artificial, y añadiendo varios productos que, según sus directivos, generarán mayores ingresos. Según más de una decena de empleados actuales y antiguos, estos ajustes forman parte de un plan de reestructuración global de OpenAI. La empresa, con sede en San Francisco, está reasignando recursos para centrarse en captar clientes empresariales de alto margen y competir con Anthro.

title_i18n.es: Cómo domar el voraz apetito energético de la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: As AI advances rapidly, its massive energy consumption draws attention. The article explores methods like optimizing algorithms, improving hardware, and adopting efficient cooling to reduce power demand in AI data centers, aiming to mitigate environmental impact without sacrificing performance.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 随着人工智能的快速发展，其巨大的能源消耗成为关注焦点。文章探讨了通过优化算法、改进硬件和采用更高效的冷却系统等方法，来降低AI数据中心的电力需求。这些措施有望在不牺牲性能的前提下，减少AI对环境的负面影响。

items.title: Where do you get the latest updates about AI?
items.raw_excerpt: Besides hacker news, of course.

title_i18n.en: Where do you get the latest updates about AI?
title_i18n.zh: 你从哪里获取关于人工智能的最新动态？
title_i18n.es: ¿Dónde obtienes las últimas actualizaciones sobre IA?

excerpt_i18n.en: Besides hacker news, of course.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章询问除了Hacker News之外，用户通常从哪里获取最新的AI资讯。这反映了AI领域信息源多样化的需求，可能涉及社交媒体、专业博客或学术平台。
excerpt_i18n.es: Además de Hacker News, por supuesto.
